utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, and I’ll bring the latest notes with me. I’ll stick to the plan and keep an eye on whatever’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Eli — I’ll bring my drill and a few spare screws. If Rey stops by, we can get the faster fixes knocked out first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Gus — let’s start with the faster fixes and then work through the rest in order. I’ll have the latest notes with me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m keeping an eye out for the repair drive details, and I’ll do my part once they come through. If Rey can help, that’s great too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m heading to the community center front desk now to check in and get the latest on the repair drive. I’ll also put together a simple task list so we can keep everything moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. I’ll watch for the details and be ready to help once you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ve got it at 10 a.m. for now, and I’ll confirm the repair drive details to Kira once the timing is fully set. Once that’s settled, I’ll keep Vik and Gus in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the pickup timing and drop-off spot before I can commit. If Quinn sends those details, please loop me in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll wait for Quinn’s pickup and drop-off details, then I’ll loop you in once the timing is locked.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Any quick update on the repair drive? I’m mostly catching things second-hand, so even a small detail would help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m putting together a quick supplies list and I’ll check with a few neighbors about donations. Mina’s set for 10 a.m., and I still need to send Oren the details so he can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps. If you get the supply list sorted, I can pass along any updates I hear too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll keep it brief and wait for your repair details after you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll send you the repair details once I’m back. Mina’s set for 10 a.m., and Vik will check with everyone and circle back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send the repair details when you’re back, and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s still at the community center front desk, and I’m checking the donations now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — thanks, Cleo. It’s still set for 10 a.m., and I’ll share the task list and start time today; if you need it, you can check the supply list too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll check the supply list too, and I’ll keep Nell posted with a quick update.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — Sunday at the community center is set, and I’m putting the notes in order by location. Mara’s on supplies and donation check-ins, and Jules can stop at the front desk when he arrives.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll sort the donated tools and hand them out as folks arrive. Glad it’s all coming together.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Dane — thank you. Your help will make the Sunday repair drive at the community center run much smoother.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great—let’s keep it at the community center front desk, and I’ll be glad for any extra hands you can round up. I’ll make sure Mina at 10 a.m. and Eli’s latest notes are part of the plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll round up a few extra hands and spread the word that the repair drive is at the community center front desk. I’ll check in with the others and keep the plan clear for everyone on the block.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. If you hear of anyone else willing to pitch in, send them my way at the community center front desk.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What still needs doing for Sunday at 10 a.m. at the community center? I can watch setup or group the notes by location.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Could you sort the donations and make a missing-items list? That’d really help for Sunday at the community center front desk.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll sort the donations and make a missing-items list for the front desk.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at the community center front desk right now. Jules is headed there to check in, so that’s the spot to use.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks — I’ll stop by the community center front desk and help if needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — the front desk at the community center is still the place to go. If anything changes, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is at the community center front desk, right? I’ll hold off telling anyone else until I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — the community center front desk is the check-in spot, and I’ll wait for the task list before spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the donations for the repair drive and let Nell know what’s already been brought in. Rey’s stopping by the community center to help, and the drive is at the front desk there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I can bring a few extra tools by the front desk if you need them. Sounds like the repair drive’s in good hands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be a big help, Gus—bring them to the front desk at the community center. I’m checking the donations now and will keep Nell posted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll send Bo the repair details once I’m back from errands. Mina’s set for 10 a.m., and Vik said he’d check with the others and circle back.

utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — it’s at 10 a.m. at the community center front desk. I’m still sorting donations, and I’ll add any missing hardware to the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’ll send Bo the repair details as soon as I’m back. Appreciate you sorting the donations and the hardware list.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it — I’m still good with 9:30 to 11:30, and I’ll work around drop-off and pick-up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll keep it marked at the community center front desk until Jules checks in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s coming together really well—people are already dropping off tools and donations. It’s still Sunday at the community center, and I’ll let Rey know if they need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what do you need done at the community center? I can bring extra hands if you want, and I’ll be there Sunday at 10 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful—could you help sort donations and keep an eye on the front desk for a bit? If anything else comes up, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn—keep me posted. I’ll stop by the community center front desk and help if needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send over the repair drive task list and start time, and I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Quinn. I’ll look for the task list and start time, and I’m happy to help out at the front desk if needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll sort the donated tools and hand them out as folks arrive. That should keep things moving without any fuss.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s mighty helpful, Dane. If anything else comes up, I can ask Rey to stop by and help out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — if you need me, I’ll keep an eye on the tools and help hand them out as people come in.

utterances.text: Nell: Hey Noah, any quick update on the repair drive? I’ve been trying to keep up from the sidelines.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ve been sorting the donations and keeping an eye on the tools for the repair drive. Cleo’s checking what’s still missing, so I’m a bit behind on the full picture.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps. If you hear anything else on what’s still missing, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s at the front desk right now. I’ll keep it simple: we still need screws, duct tape, and one replacement hinge.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm — it’s definitely at the community center front desk, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, the community center front desk. I’m keeping it simple—screws, duct tape, and one replacement hinge still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It’s set for 10 a.m., so I’ll confirm the details to Kira now. After that, I’ll loop Vik and Gus in so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thank you—I'll be at the community center front desk and glad for the extra hands. If anything shifts, just let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — I’ll keep it at 10 a.m. and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m heading to the community center front desk to check in now. I’ll also put together a simple task list so we can keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — that’ll help a lot. I’m checking in with a few neighbors about donations, and I’ll keep an eye out for Mina at 10.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll check in at the front desk and get the task list started. If you hear any timing updates for drop-offs or pickup, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll check with the others and repeat the plan so everyone stays on the same page. I’ll circle back after I’ve talked to folks and keep the repair drive clear for the whole block.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep organizing the notes, and we’ll stay set for Sunday at the community center.
